_doc: Restaurants whose prix-fixe value was worked out by hand, so the price sweep must not spend a crawl on them. Slugs, not names: run a name through the pipeline's slugify rather than typing it -- '&' becomes 'and' and a leading 'The' is dropped, and three entries here were wrong on exactly that for a whole season.
_corrected: 2026-09-17: the-bronx-beer-hall -> bronx-beer-hall, mae-mae-cafe-plant-shop -> mae-mae-cafe-and-plant-shop, code-red-restaurant-lounge -> code-red-restaurant-and-lounge. catch-nyc is left as-is: no venue of that name is in the listing, so it is a departure, not a typo.
